title: PedVAE | PSC | NHSN | CDC
content: Pediatric Ventilator-associated Events (PedVAE) Print Minus Related Pages Available In-Plan for Pediatric and Neonatal Inpatient Locations Only. PedVAP surveillance using the PNEU protocol continues to be available for in-plan surveillance for pediatric locations only. See VAE for in-plan surveillance for adult locations Not available for Inpatient Psychiatric Facilities (IPFs) PedVAE Calculator operates based upon the currently posted PedVAE protocol.
